run_do_rollouts: run rollouts on a game with given order sets and agent power to get scores
run_do_rollouts_multi: run multi-model rollouts on a game with order sets and extra strategy models
run_do_rollouts_maybe_cached: run rollouts with optional cache lookup to avoid recomputing identical order sets
run_do_rollouts_multi_maybe_cached: run multi-model rollouts with optional cache lookup to avoid recomputing identical order sets
build_RolloutResultsCache: build a RolloutResultsCache instance to cache and retrieve rollout results by joint action
